build_from_cfg: build a module instance from a config dict using a Registry and default arguments
create_Registry: create a Registry object to map strings to classes or functions for deferred instantiation
register_module: register a class or function in a Registry using the register_module decorator or method
build_from_Registry: build an object from a Registry by calling its build method with a type config dict
get_from_Registry: get a registered class or function from a Registry by its key name or scoped key
